changelog.0.1.0: Initial kidney and renal-mass CT segmentation bundle.

task: Kidney and renal-mass segmentation on contrast-enhanced abdominal CT
description: 3D SegResNet that segments kidney and renal mass on contrast CT. Trained on the C4KC-KiTS collection (TCIA) with clinician DICOM-SEG reference labels. Illustrative portfolio bundle, not a medical device.
data_source: C4KC-KiTS, The Cancer Imaging Archive, doi:10.7937/TCIA.2019.IX49E8NX, CC BY 3.0
image_classes: single-channel contrast-enhanced abdominal CT, intensity windowed to [-200, 300] HU then scaled to [0, 1]
intended_use: Illustrative concurrent-read segmentation aid for research and portfolio demonstration only. Not for clinical use.
